scenes.tts: Is it alive? One clue is never enough. Living things grow, need water, air and food, react to changes, and make more of their kind. A toy car moves, but it is not alive.
scenes.narration: Is it alive? One clue is never enough. Living things grow, need water, air and food, react to changes, and make more of their kind. A toy car moves, but it is not alive.

items.text: Living things grow, react, make more
A toy car moves, but is not alive

scenes.tts: Fill a basket with ten to twelve things from around the house. Mix a rock, a toy car, a dry leaf, an apple, and a houseplant. Add one or two large dry beans.
scenes.narration: Fill a basket with ten to twelve things from around the house. Mix a rock, a toy car, a dry leaf, an apple, and a houseplant. Add one or two large dry beans.

scenes.tts: Ask your child to sort everything into two piles, alive and not alive. Ask how they decided, and write down their rule. Do not correct it yet. Next, build a checklist from a pet or plant, and test each object.
scenes.narration: Ask your child to sort everything into two piles, alive and not alive. Ask how they decided, and write down their rule. Do not correct it yet. Next, build a checklist from a pet or plant, and test each object.

scenes.tts: Spend the most time on the seed, the toy car, and the dry leaf. A resting seed is alive, though it shows few clues today, and a toy car is not. It is fine to leave a question open.
scenes.narration: Spend the most time on the seed, the toy car, and the dry leaf. A resting seed is alive, though it shows few clues today, and a toy car is not. It is fine to leave a question open.

scenes.tts: Stay with your child. Keep beans and other small objects away from children under four. Nothing from the basket is for eating.
scenes.narration: Stay with your child. Keep beans and other small objects away from children under four. Nothing from the basket is for eating.

scenes.line: No single clue decides whether something is alive.
